يتباطأ (form VI)

# يَتَبَاطَأَ (yatabāṭaʔa) /ja.ta.baː.tˤa.ʔa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa)
# يَتَبَاطَأْ (yatabāṭaʔ) /ja.ta.baː.tˤaʔ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَبَاطَأَ (tabāṭaʔa
